Name: Mark Walters
DOB: 1993
Medical History: Type 1 Diabetes for 14 years
Current Regimen: Lantus 10 units subcut daily in the morning, Novolog 6 units subcut with meals
Daily glycemic logs over the past 2 weeks range from 60 to 280 mg/dL
Last HbA1c: 8.5%
No major comorbidities
Reason for referral: advanced insulin pump therapy

This is a 28-year-old man, Mark Walters, who has been managing Type 1 Diabetes with multiple daily injections for over a decade. He is seeking better glycemic control and consistent insulin delivery through an insulin pump. 

Write this in a better understandable way as a formal referral letter to an endocrinologist for possible insulin pump therapy
